run_f_gold: run f_gold with m and n to count sequences where each element equals twice the previous
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the dynamic programming recurrence T[i][j] = T[i-1][j] + T[i//2][j-1] used in f_gold
review_f_gold: review f_gold DP table initialization and base cases for edge conditions like i < j or j == 1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(m*n) to O(m) by using a 1D DP array
